package.angle: These clips cover Bitcoin ownership, an undervaluation view, intermediaries getting hacked, and Bitcoin's move from 16K to 126K.

segments.label: hook
segments.text: Bitcoin does not have any authority that allows people to take the wealth of others. If some people end up with more Bitcoin, that's because they chose to do that.

segments.label: clip_01
segments.text: However, I think Bitcoin is by far the most undervalued asset in like the entire global financial system right now. So, you know, Bitcoin gold parity is around like $1.5, $1.4 million per Bitcoin last I checked. It's very, very undervalued.

segments.label: clip_02
segments.text: It's not Bitcoin that's getting hacked. It's other intermediaries. So in some ways, it kind of shines a light on the secure nature and the unique nature of Bitcoin.

segments.label: clip_03
segments.text: Bitcoin ran from 16K to 126K. That move comes out to about an 8x.
